newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN DEPUTY PM OFFERS SUPPORT TO REFEREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN DEPUTY PM OFFERS SUPPORT TO REFEREE.

text.p: Italian referee Pier Luigi Collina, at the centre of controversy after disallowing a goal which Internazionale thought they had scored in a 0-0 draw with Juventus on Sunday, has received support from an unexpected source.
Italian Deputy Prime Minister and Sports Minister Walter Veltroni praised the referee's decision to change his mind and overrule a goal he had at first seemed to consider valid.
"Collina did very well. I was very impressed by the fact that he went across to the Inter bench to explain why the Inter striker (Maurizio) Ganz was offside," said Veltroni.
Inter fans, however, are unlikely to be impressed by the Deputy Prime Minister's comments - Veltroni is a well-known Juventus fan.
